title: Report theorem-type definition surface

traversal_policy.roots: Every top-level theorem declared in namespace KFOL.Report in Report.lean; traverse its type, never its proof body.
traversal_policy.project_expansion: Recursively traverse declaration types, non-proof definition/opaque bodies, and reachable inductive constructor types in modules KFOL.*, Paper or Report.
traversal_policy.proof_erasure: Lean.Meta.isProof erases proof-valued subterms with local binders in scope, including proof-only helper definitions. Proposition expressions themselves remain: predicates and hypotheses contribute their mathematical definitions.
traversal_policy.inductives: Reachable inductive declarations include their constructors and mutual inductive declarations. Kernel-generated recursors are indexed by their types; their computation rules are supplied by Lean's inductive kernel.
traversal_policy.external_boundary: Record directly referenced external constants and their declared types without unfolding their definitions or traversing the external dependency closure.
traversal_policy.purpose: A reproducible index for reviewing the mathematical meaning of public statements. It does not establish that a definition matches the manuscript, replace human review, or replace the independent source/import/axiom audits.

review_order: Read each public theorem's literal type in Report.lean and its per-theorem slice below.

Review central KFOL/Definitions files, then the extra semantic definitions reached in algorithm/round/machine files. Source fingerprints and exact declaration edges identify that complete project surface.
Review the imported GameTheory and ComplexityLib/Cslib boundary types separately. External boundary entries are interfaces, not a claim that their full definition closure was audited here.
Use the existing whole-project axiom/import audit for proof dependencies; they are deliberately absent from this report.

∀ {Role : Type u} {Var : Type v} [Finite Role] (t : KFOL.Term Role Var) (ν : Var → KFOL.WinnerSet Role),
  (↑(KFOL.Term.eval ν t)).ncard + KFOL.Term.absorbingCount ν t ≤ KFOL.Term.leafMass ν t

∀ {Role : Type u} (owner : Role) (Action : Type v) (nonempty : Nonempty Action)
  (next : Action → KFOL.Strategic.QuantifiedTree Role),
  (KFOL.Strategic.QuantifiedTree.node owner Action nonempty next).possibleWinners =
    if ∃ a, (next a).possibleWinners = {owner} then {owner} else {player | ∃ a, player ∈ (next a).possibleWinners}

∀ {Role : Type u} {Var : Type v} [Finite Role] (t : KFOL.Term Role Var) (ν : Var → KFOL.WinnerSet Role),
  (∀ (x : Var), (↑(ν x)).ncard = 1) → (↑(KFOL.Term.eval ν t)).ncard ≤ min (Nat.card Role) (t.choiceCount + 1)

∀ {Role : Type u} [inst : Fintype Role] [inst_1 : DecidableEq Role] (a b c : Role),

    a ≠ c →
      b ≠ c →
        ∀ (order : GameTheory.Languages.Bridges.FOSGToEFG.ExplicitOrder Role) (N : ℕ) {Summary : Type v}
          [inst_2 : Fintype Summary] (code : Fin (N + 1) → Summary),
          (∀ (n k : Fin (N + 1)),
              code n = code k →
                ∀ (m : Fin N),
                  c ∈
                      KFOL.Rounds.Game.possibleWinners
                        ((KFOL.Rounds.Game.threshold a b c (↑n) (↑m + 1)).sequentialValues order) ↔
                    c ∈
                      KFOL.Rounds.Game.possibleWinners
                        ((KFOL.Rounds.Game.threshold a b c (↑k) (↑m + 1)).sequentialValues order)) →
            Function.Injective code ∧ N + 1 ≤ Fintype.card Summary

  (∀ (A B C : Set α), mul (mul A B) C = mul A (mul B C)) →
    (∀ (A B C : Set α), mul (A ∪ B) C = mul A C ∪ mul B C) →
      (∀ (A B C : Set α), mul A (B ∪ C) = mul A B ∪ mul A C) →

                      KFOL.Relational.regularRelation mul A x y ∨ KFOL.Relational.regularRelation mul B x y) ∧
                  ∀ (A B : Set α),

project_declarations.type:
∀ {Role : Type u} [inst : Fintype Role] [inst_1 : DecidableEq Role] (a b c : Role),
  a ≠ b →
    a ≠ c →
      b ≠ c →
        ∀ (order : GameTheory.Languages.Bridges.FOSGToEFG.ExplicitOrder Role) (N : ℕ) {Summary : Type v}
          [inst_2 : Fintype Summary] (code : Fin (N + 1) → Summary),
          (∀ (n k : Fin (N + 1)),
              code n = code k →
                ∀ (m : Fin N),
                  c ∈
                      KFOL.Rounds.Game.possibleWinners
                        ((KFOL.Rounds.Game.threshold a b c (↑n) (↑m + 1)).sequentialValues order) ↔
                    c ∈
                      KFOL.Rounds.Game.possibleWinners
                        ((KFOL.Rounds.Game.threshold a b c (↑k) (↑m + 1)).sequentialValues order)) →
            Function.Injective code ∧ N + 1 ≤ Fintype.card Summary

project_declarations.type:
∀ {Role : Type u} {Var : Type v} [inst : Fintype Role] [inst_1 : Fintype Var] (three : Fin 3 ↪ Role)
  (G : (k : Role) → (j : Var) → Finset (KFOL.Core.Sources.Guard k j)),
  (∃ t, t.IsCore ∧ (KFOL.Core.Sources.normalForm three fun v => KFOL.Term.eval v t) = G) ↔
    ∃ n H label,
      0 < n ∧
        H.NoRainbow ∧
          H.NoAlternatingPath ∧
            ∀ (k : Role) (j : Var) (g : KFOL.Core.Sources.Guard k j),
              g ∈ G k j ↔
                KFOL.Core.Sources.Prime (fun p => H.Wins Set.univ label (KFOL.Core.Sources.probe three k j p) k) g

project_declarations.type:

  (values : Row → Var → KFOL.WinnerSet Role) (U : Row → KFOL.WinnerSet Role) (B : KFOL.Core.Cuts.State Role Row),
  (∃ i r, { bounds := B, row := i, winner := r } ∈ KFOL.FiniteHorn.saturate (KFOL.Core.Cuts.system values U)) →
    ∃ t,
      t.IsCore ∧
        (∀ (i : Row), ↑(KFOL.Term.eval (values i) t) ⊆ KFOL.Core.Cuts.region U B i) ∧
          ∀ (i : Row) (r : Role),
            r ∈ ↑(KFOL.Term.eval (values i) t) ↔
              { bounds := B, row := i, winner := r } ∈ KFOL.FiniteHorn.saturate (KFOL.Core.Cuts.system values U)

project_declarations.type:
∀ (n : ℕ),
  ∃ equation term,
    equation.WellFormed ∧
      equation.gates.length = 6 * n + 3 ∧
        List.countP
              (fun gate =>
                match gate with
                | KFOL.Circuit.Gate.input a => true
                | KFOL.Circuit.Gate.func a a_1 => false)
              equation.gates =
            2 * n + 2 ∧
          KFOL.Circuit.operationCount equation.gates = 4 * n + 1 ∧
            KFOL.Circuit.edgeCount equation.gates = 8 * n + 2 ∧
              equation.unfold = some (term, term) ∧
                (term.table (Sum.inl true)).card = 2 ^ n ∧
                  (∀ A ∈ term.table (Sum.inl true), A.card = n + 1) ∧
                    term.occurrences (Sum.inl true) = 2 ^ n ∧
                      ∀ (Role : Type u) (_three : Fin 3 ↪ Role) (other : KFOL.Reset.Term (Bool ⊕ ℕ × Bool)),
                        (∀ (valuation : Bool ⊕ ℕ × Bool → KFOL.WinnerSet Role),
                            other.eval valuation = term.eval valuation) →
                          2 ^ n ≤ other.occurrences (Sum.inl true) ∧
                            2 ^ n + 1 ≤ other.leafCount ∧ 2 ^ (n + 1) + 1 ≤ other.size

∀ {Var : Type v} {Var' : Type w} [inst : DecidableEq Var] [inst_1 : DecidableEq Var'] (t : KFOL.Reset.Term Var)
  (inner : Var → KFOL.Reset.Term Var'),

    (∀ {Role : Type u} (valuation : Var' → KFOL.WinnerSet Role),

project_declarations.name: KFOL.Report.scalar_diagonal_security
project_declarations.type:
∀ {Role : Type u} [inst : DecidableEq Role] [inst_1 : Fintype Role] (a b : Role),
  a ≠ b →
    ∀ (x y : ℝ) (hx0 : 0 ≤ x) (hx1 : x ≤ 1) (hy0 : 0 ≤ y) (hy1 : y ≤ 1),
      0 < x + y →
        ∃ row col,
          (row 0).toReal = y / (x + y) ∧
            (col 0).toReal = y / (x + y) ∧
              ∀ (profile : (i : Role) → PMF (Fin (KFOL.Rounds.Game.binarySizes a b i + 1))),
                (((KFOL.Rounds.Game.stageForm (KFOL.Rounds.Game.binarySizes a b)
                                (KFOL.Rounds.Game.Scalar.diagonalTable a b
                                  (KFOL.Rounds.Game.Scalar.distribution a b x hx0 hx1)
                                  (KFOL.Rounds.Game.Scalar.distribution a b y hy0 hy1))).mixed.play
                          (GameTheory.Profile.update profile a row))
                        a).toReal =
                    x * y / (x + y) ∧
                  (((KFOL.Rounds.Game.stageForm (KFOL.Rounds.Game.binarySizes a b)
                                (KFOL.Rounds.Game.Scalar.diagonalTable a b
                                  (KFOL.Rounds.Game.Scalar.distribution a b x hx0 hx1)
                                  (KFOL.Rounds.Game.Scalar.distribution a b y hy0 hy1))).mixed.play
                          (GameTheory.Profile.update profile b col))
                        a).toReal =
                    x * y / (x + y)

    (∀ (A B : KFOL.WinnerSet Role),
        KFOL.TwoPlayers.forcingCoordinates labels (KFOL.WinnerSet.choice (labels 0) A B) =
          ((KFOL.TwoPlayers.forcingCoordinates labels A).1 || (KFOL.TwoPlayers.forcingCoordinates labels B).1,
            (KFOL.TwoPlayers.forcingCoordinates labels A).2 && (KFOL.TwoPlayers.forcingCoordinates labels B).2)) ∧
      (∀ (A B : KFOL.WinnerSet Role),
          KFOL.TwoPlayers.forcingCoordinates labels (KFOL.WinnerSet.choice (labels 1) A B) =
            ((KFOL.TwoPlayers.forcingCoordinates labels A).1 && (KFOL.TwoPlayers.forcingCoordinates labels B).1,
              (KFOL.TwoPlayers.forcingCoordinates labels A).2 || (KFOL.TwoPlayers.forcingCoordinates labels B).2)) ∧
        (∀ (A : KFOL.WinnerSet Role),
            KFOL.TwoPlayers.forcingCoordinates labels (KFOL.WinnerSet.rename (Equiv.swap (labels 0) (labels 1)) A) =
              ((KFOL.TwoPlayers.forcingCoordinates labels A).2, (KFOL.TwoPlayers.forcingCoordinates labels A).1)) ∧
          ∀ (p : Bool × Bool), (∃ A, KFOL.TwoPlayers.forcingCoordinates labels A = p) ↔ ¬(p.1 = true ∧ p.2 = true)
